summary.en: Register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Ministry of Revenues. Required for almost everything formal: opening a business, getting a license, bank accounts for companies, and paying taxes.
summary.am: ከገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ጋር የግብር መለያ ቁጥር (ታቢ) ያስመዝግቡ። ንግድ ለመጀመር፣ ፈቃድ ለማግኘትና ግብር ለመክፈል ይፈለጋል።

description.en: Gather your ID, proof of address and photos. For business TIN registration you also need your business name certificate (if registered) and details of your business activity.

responsible_office.en: Yourself (no office visit needed for this step)
responsible_office.am: እርስዎ ራስዎ (ለዚህ እርምጃ ቢሮ መሄድ አያስፈልግም)

label.en: Proof of address (utility bill or lease agreement)

title.en: Visit the Ministry of Revenues branch office
title.am: የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ቅርንጫፍ ጽህፈት ቤት ይጎብኙ

description.en: Go to the branch office that serves your area (in Addis Ababa: the sub-city tax office or the main MoR branches). Get a queue number and collect the TIN application form from the customer service desk.
description.am: አካባቢዎን ወደሚያገለግለው የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ቅርንጫፍ ይሂዱና የማመልከቻ ቅጹን ይውሰዱ።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Revenues — sub-city tax office / branch
responsible_office.am: የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር — የክፍለ ከተማ የግብር ጽህፈት ቤት

title.en: Fill in and submit the application form

description.en: Fill the TIN application form with your personal details and, for businesses, the business details. Submit it together with your documents at the designated counter. You may be asked for a business profile or lease documents if registering as a business.
description.am: የታቢ ማመልከቻ ቅጹን ይሙሉና ከሰነዶችዎ ጋር ያቅርቡ።

description.en: For individuals the TIN is often issued the same day after verification. If your file needs review you will be told when to return. Keep the certificate safe — you will need it for licenses, bank accounts and every future process.
description.am: ታቢዎ በዚያው ቀን ሊሰጥ ይችላል። የምስክር ወረቀቱን በደህና ያስቀምጡ።

common_rejection_reasons.en: ID document unreadable, expired, or details mismatch between documents
common_rejection_reasons.am: መታወቂያው የማይነበብ ወይም ዝርዝሮቹ የማይዛመዱ ናቸው

common_rejection_reasons.en: Business TIN requested without business registration documents
common_rejection_reasons.am: የንግድ ታቢ ያለ የንግድ ምዝገባ ሰነዶች

common_rejection_reasons.en: Lease/address proof missing or not in the applicant's name
Duplicate registration — person already has an active TIN

notes.en: Addis Ababa has dedicated tax offices per sub-city plus central MoR branches. Same-day issuance is common for individuals.
notes.am: አዲስ አበባ በክፍለ ከተማ የግብር ጽህፈት ቤቶች አሉት።

notes.en: Ministry of Revenues Bahir Dar branch serves the Amhara region. Regional office queues can be longer during tax season (June–July).
notes.am: ባህር ዳር የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ቅርንጫፍ የአማራ ክልልን ያገለግላል።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Revenues — Bahir Dar branch

notes.en: Ministry of Revenues Mekelle branch. Check current operating status before travelling.
Ministry of Revenues Jimma branch serves the surrounding Oromia zones. Queues can be long around tax filing season (June–July).
notes.am: የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ጅማ ቅርንጫፍ በዙሪያው ያሉትን የኦሮሚያ ዞኖች ያገለግላል።

notes.en: Ministry of Revenues Gondar branch serves the Amhara region's north-west. Same-day issuance is common for individual TINs.
notes.am: የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ጎንደር ቅርንጫፍ የአማራ ክልልን ሰሜን-ምዕራብ ያገለግላል።

notes.en: Ministry of Revenues Adama branch. A busy corridor office — arrive early, as queues build through the morning.
notes.am: የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር አዳማ ቅርንጫፍ። ሰው በበዛበት ቢሮ ነው — ቶሎ ይሂዱ።
